protocol_name: CRTFE-HCM Dorian Phase Relation transferability test - Stage 1A fixed-K amendment
reason_for_amendment: The first implementation varied u by varying K at fixed fm, causing Kd to reach 4.712 rad/cell at u=0.05 and changing the spatial modulation geometry across u. That does not match the intended fixed-geometry velocity-scaling test or the earlier validated u-sweep. Stage 1A fixes Kd and varies fm to set u. No Stage-1 held-out score is used for fitting or threshold changes.
supersedes_for_physics_verdict: CRTFE-HCM_TRANSFERABILITY_PROTOCOL_FROZEN_2026-09-10.json Stage-1 u-control path only; the failed Stage-1 result is retained as an implementation-control record.
fixed_spatial_phase_per_cell_description: pi/6, equal to M=4 periods over the canonical N=48 V1 ladder; length changes preserve this same per-cell modulation geometry, so total modulation periods scale with N

retrieval_and_models.one_time_fit: fit C,D on training only then freeze

full_sideband_limit: Stage 1A releases converged h=-15..15 Floquet scattering but does not claim a full-sideband reduced-effective-model prediction PASS because that separate reduced Floquet constitutive model has not yet been specified.
